# MultiSendCallOnly

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/aae683920cd57dc96d920c3e2d788e226f098aef/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/libraries/MultiSendCallOnly.sol)

**Title:** Multi Send Call Only - Allows to batch multiple transactions into one, but only calls

**Authors:** Stefan George - @Georgi87, Richard Meissner - @rmeissner

The guard logic is not required here as this contract doesn't support nested delegate calls

## Functions

<a id="multisend-bytes"></a>

### multiSend

<i>

Sends multiple transactions and reverts all if one fails.

</i>

The code is for most part the same as the normal MultiSend (to keep compatibility),
        but reverts if a transaction tries to use a delegatecall.

This method is payable as delegatecalls keep the msg.value from the previous call
        If the calling method (e.g. execTransaction) received ETH this would revert otherwise

```solidity
function multiSend(bytes memory transactions) public payable;
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| transactions | `bytes` | Encoded transactions. Each transaction is encoded as a packed bytes of<br/>                    operation has to be uint8(0) in this version (=> 1 byte),<br/>                    to as a address (=> 20 bytes),<br/>                    value as a uint256 (=> 32 bytes),<br/>                    data length as a uint256 (=> 32 bytes),<br/>                    data as bytes.<br/>                    see abi.encodePacked for more information on packed encoding |
